card.name: Intended/indicated before 'for use'
card.fires_on: The words 'intended' or 'indicated' right after 'is' or 'only', where 'for use' comes next in a device or product label. Also fires on 'Warnings' in 'see Warnings and Precautions' cross-references.

modes.label: Intended / indicated for
modes.description: The word 'intended' or 'indicated' after 'is', leading into 'for use' or a use statement.

modes.label: Warnings cross-reference
modes.description: The start of 'Warnings' inside a bracketed 'see Warnings and Precautions' reference.

modes.label: Use in claims
modes.description: The word 'use' after 'for' in a computer program claim.
modes.example: A computer program product in computer readable media for<< use>> in a data processing system for recording events
